name: Koch family (Buffalo, New Era Cap)
note: Founding family of New Era Cap (Ehrhardt Koch founded it in Buffalo, NY in 1920); fourth-generation Chris Koch is CEO. Reuters (2024-06-06): New Era is controlled by its founding family, with ACON Investments holding a significant stake. Not related to Koch, Inc. (Koch Industries), the Wichita conglomerate owned by a different Koch family.
